facts.fact: The Congolese finance ministry's arretes of 20 June 2025 cite CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC Regulation No. 04/18 of 21 December 2018 on payment services as the governing text for payment institutions.
Arrete No. 2708/MFBPP-CAB of 27 May 2022 approved Mobile Money Congo S.a as a payment institution (etablissement de paiement), per the Journal officiel of 3 July 2025.
